narr: Modest moisture remained across the region with an upper level disturbance moving through northerly flow aloft. This disturbance triggered a severe thunderstorm east of Deming and some flash flooding around the Truth or Consequences area.
ev: Sierra County dispatch reported flooding across Truth or Consequences, Elephant Butte and Williamsburg.
